description: Store binary content with metadata in blob storage. Returns unique blob_id for later retrieval.
embedding_description: Save file to blob storage. Upload binary content. Store audio image document. Persist file with metadata. Save generated output. Write binary data. File upload storage. result_processor_customizations.result_description: Storage confirmation with blob_id (unique identifier for retrieval), size (bytes stored), namespace, and any user-provided metadata
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Stores binary content (files, images, audio, etc.) in blob storage with metadata
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: ValidationError: content or namespace invalid. StorageError: blob storage service unavailable or quota exceeded. NamespaceError: namespace does not exist or access denied.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For validation errors: check content encoding and namespace format. For storage errors: retry or check service status. For quota errors: consider deleting old blobs or contact admin.
